final_answer: An agent can plan, act, observe the result, and repeat. Source: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents
The loop lets an agent plan a step, act through a tool, and observe feedback. Source: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents
A checkpointer saves thread-scoped graph state, while a store holds cross-thread memory. Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/persistence
The checkpointer preserves one thread's execution state; the store keeps durable data beyond that thread. Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/persistence

Multi-agent research is justified when the problem contains independent search trajectories. Workers use local context for exploration and compression; the lead owns resource policy, graph expansion, stopping, and synthesis. Stateful runs require checkpoint and resume. Source: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/multi-agent-research-system

Independent exploratory branches can spend separate context and tool budgets, then return compression artifacts to an executive. The exact path may vary, but verification, checkpoint recovery, citations, and stop conditions remain required. Source: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/multi-agent-research-system
